scope: Using the one canonical F portable shared runner, sequentially inspect up to 120 post-row-30 candidates and add up to 25 rows only when a real internet listing opens and contains a positive land or plot signal. Write each accepted row to the website JSON immediately and save a compact source-evidence JSON with URL, HTTP status, extracted facts and HTML SHA256.
acceptance: Only successfully opened real internet listing pages with positive land or plot evidence may be added.
Every accepted row must be visible row-by-row on the 8012 website after refresh.
Every accepted row must contain listing_url, local_source_path, source_content_sha256, batch_id, evidence_updated_at, run_status, status_json_path and report_md_path.
No visual_match_score, VISION_COMPARED status or 3.5+ confidence without real downloaded photos, canonical polygon render and real vision comparison.
Git work commit and remote branch readback must be recorded.
Do not create or request another runner.
